catalyst_text: Presented positive long term Phase 3 OLE results
detailed_catalyst_text: Long-term open-label extension results from the Phase 3 DUPLEX study in focal segmental glomerulosclerosis showed durable and deepening proteinuria reductions, with increasing rates of complete and partial remission over time. Patients who switched from irbesartan to treatment experienced rapid and sustained proteinuria reductions comparable to those initially treated. Safety was consistent with prior findings and the therapy was generally well tolerated for up to five years.
catalyst_text_evidence: Travere Therapeutics, Inc., (NASDAQ:TVTX) today announced long-term results from the ongoing Phase 3 DUPLEX Study open-label extension (OLE) of FILSPARI (sparsentan) in the treatment of focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS). The results were presented at the European Renal Association (ERA) 2026 Congress in Glasgow, Scotland 2026-06-03 to 2026-06-06. Patients who initiated FILSPARI in the double-blind period and remained on therapy in the OLE maintained durable reductions in proteinuria, resulting in further achievement of clinically meaningful low proteinuria thresholds over time. Patients who transitioned from active control maximum labeled dose irbesartan to FILSPARI at the start of the OLE subsequently demonstrated rapid and sustained reductions in proteinuria similar to those who initiated FILSPARI at the beginning of the double-blind period. FILSPARI was generally well tolerated for up to five years of follow-up in the study.

drug_indication: Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis without nephrotic syndrome
catalyst_text: Received FDA approval for FSGS without nephrotic syndrome
detailed_catalyst_text: The FDA approved sparsentan to reduce proteinuria in adults and children aged 8 and older with focal segmental glomerulosclerosis without nephrotic syndrome. This represents the first FDA-approved therapy for FSGS and expands the medicine’s label beyond IgA nephropathy, potentially broadening patient access.
catalyst_text_evidence: Ligand Pharmaceuticals Incorporated (NASDAQ:LGND) today announced that its partner Travere Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:TVTX) has received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for FILSPARI® (sparsentan) to reduce proteinuria in adult and pediatric patients aged 8 years and older with focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) without nephrotic syndrome. FILSPARI is the first and only medicine approved by the FDA for the treatment of FSGS, marking its expansion beyond IgA nephropathy (IgAN) into a second rare kidney disease.
